ios.desc:
Audiobooks - player, made with love for audiobooks

I listen to 30–50 audiobooks a year and built this player for myself. It plays your own DRM-free audiobooks (m4b, mp3, flac and more) with chapters, and picks up exactly where you left off.

Free, no ads, no tracking, no subscription. The only paid extra is turning an EPUB into an audiobook with cloud voices, a one-time purchase per book.

Key Features:
- Convert EPUB to Audiobooks
- Share audio clips: trim and export a segment to share (up to 60 seconds)
- Auto timer: start a sleep timer automatically during your bedtime hours
- Stream and download books from your Audiobookshelf or Jellyfin server
- Home Screen widgets to jump back into your current book
- Bookmarks: save and return to any moment
- Game controller support
- Siri Shortcuts to add books and resume playback
- Listening stats and history to track the books you've finished
- Liquid Glass design
- Seek undo: Accidentally skipped ahead? A button appears to return to your previous position
- Customizable skip buttons: 15s, 30s, 45s, 60s
- Sort and filter your library by title, duration, or progress
- Grid or List layout for your library
- Edit book details and set custom cover art
- Adjust playback speed (0.25x-4x with 0.1 step)
- Automatic cover art from folder images or embedded metadata
- Include your audiobooks in iCloud Backup
- Add books via iTunes/Finder or iOS Files app, AirDrop or over Wi-Fi from your browser
- Translated into 20 languages

quotes.text:
I had a bunch of ebooks with no audiobook version available. So I built an
iOS app that converts EPUB files into audiobooks using text-to-speech.

Two voice options:
- Free on-device voices (processed locally, no server needed)
- Natural cloud voices (one-time purchase per book, no subscription)

Cloud conversion runs chunk by chunk. You can start listening other chapters generate in the background. Once done, the audiobook lives on your device.

No account required. No subscription. You import your own EPUBs and either use device TTS for free or pay per book for the cloud voices.

Nothing stored on backend, neither books or audio files.
